In this release, mostly compatibility with the latest released Cyberpunk Red - Core system is done. It also adds one new feature.
When ever a gun is fired it will create an ambient light source for the given shots. That is only possible when the module [Automated Animations](https://github.com/otigon/automated-jb2a-animations) is used for the animation and the module [DF Active Lights](https://foundryvtt.com/packages/df-active-lights) is present.
Of course if you do not wish for light sources to be created, you can always disable this within the module's settings.

Added cover token feature, it creates tokens which will be used to track HP of cover. These tokens are invisible for players by default, there is a setting to make them visible by default.
With this release a new compendium was added, search for the `CPR Additions: Macros` compendium inside the macros section, there you will find a new macro to use this new feature.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/diwako/foundry-cyberpunk-red-core-additions/compare/0.3.0...0.3.1
